name: Razor Shark

features.name: Mystery stacks
features.description: Mystery stacks reveal matching symbols, sometimes with a Razor Reveal multiplier.

features.name: Free spins with progressive multiplier
features.description: Each reveal increases the multiplier during free spins.

review:
An underwater game with mystery stacks that reveal symbols – and, through the Razor Reveal, multipliers and cash.

In free spins, a progressive multiplier gives the bonus a great sense of momentum, and the 50,000x cap is a big step up from most underwater slots. High volatility, 96.7% RTP. The demo opens on Push Gaming's own site.
